text.text:
According to Dust, everything is not clear.
Everyone knows that Turks are "dumbstruck by dust." And in April, they showed a good Blast game against the tops. 
Brazilians on this map, skillfully lose to their fellow countrymen, and take them back with the fight. There are absolutely few games with Europe.
 Judging by the extreme games, the Turks have hardly changed the tactical component since the Major in Austin.
If you really want to pour for the match, then a small TO will do. Otherwise, Aurora should pick it up.
Anubis
It's a good map for Aurora. Even though they flew away from the Kazakhs in overtime. XD. Almost the same defense and defense, based on the percentage of rounds taken. 
The last matches show the preparation. 
Brazilians only have experience with Brazilians (well, 90% of the games).
Looking at the past games, the Brazilians have prepared something for Astana. I expect a fight, and the total number of rounds is more.
